name: Dagric Design Language
principles: One recognizable Dagric system from boot through recovery
Motion explains change; it is never decoration
Performance is part of the visual system
User choice is visible, reversible and respected

typography.weightPolicy: regular for body, medium for controls, semibold for hierarchy

motion.reducedMotion: replace travel and scale with a short opacity fade

surfaces.blur: reserved for shell surfaces where separation needs it
surfaces.transparency: restrained; never reduce text contrast or obscure content
surfaces.shadow: soft single shadow; no stacked glow
surfaces.border: one-pixel separation when contrast alone is insufficient

rules.accentUse: state, focus, progress and critical actions only
rules.themeAccent: Pulse Red anchors Dagric Flow; user-selected styles may choose another deliberate accent
rules.bodyText: never pulseRed on a dark background
rules.wallpaper: static by default; no live compositing cost
rules.thirdPartyMarks: Dagric helpers use original generic artwork unless written permission or an applicable brand policy authorizes a mark
rules.confirmation: destructive, privileged and third-party installation actions require a clear owner decision
rules.copy: plain language first; package and compatibility details remain available under advanced guidance

signatureSurfaces.panel: quiet bottom edge with a branded launcher and readable status area
signatureSurfaces.launcher: search-first access to applications, files, settings and actions
signatureSurfaces.controlCenter: one coherent place for immediate device state and controls
signatureSurfaces.appearance: live preview with automatic revert for display-affecting changes
signatureSurfaces.recovery: plain-language repair choices that explain risk before acting
